editorial:
Imagine living in a small town where everyone already hates you because your dad is a convicted killer. That is exactly what Alison and Brandon are dealing with. When more people start turning up dead, the town doesn't even look for other clues; they just point the finger at the siblings. You will feel the tension as these two try to survive the gossip and the police while figuring out who the real monster is. The movie has a dark, moody vibe that makes you feel like something bad is always about to happen around the corner.

The acting is solid and keeps you invested in whether these kids are actually innocent or hiding something. While the story moves a bit slow in the middle, the twists at the end make the wait worth it. If you enjoy a good mystery that keeps you guessing, you should definitely give this a shot. It is a great pick for a rainy weekend when you want something a bit creepy.
endingExplained: You find out that the real killer was not the father, but someone closer to home. The twist reveals that the killings were tied to secrets from the past that the town wanted to keep hidden. After a tense showdown, the real murderer is finally caught, and the siblings are cleared of all charges. It ends with the family finally getting some peace, though they are forever changed by the trauma they went through.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves small-town murder mysteries and family dramas.
